lines.zh: 小翅膀扇得急，走起来一跳一跳
lines.en: My little wings flap fast and I bounce along.
Small, but not slow.

lines.zh: 我像影子一样从你脚边滑过去
lines.en: I slide past your feet like a shadow.

lines.zh: 蓝壳上的斑点是天生的
lines.en: The spots on my blue shell are born with me.

lines.zh: 尾巴甩来甩去，停不下来
lines.en: My tail swings about and won't keep still.
We walk in a crowd; don't try to count.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，风都带不起来
lines.en: I keep low; I can't even raise wind.

lines.zh: 四只一起走，地上就乱了
lines.en: Four of us walking and the ground is a mess.

lines.zh: 我步子碎，一眨眼就挪了位
lines.en: My steps are quick and small; blink and I've moved.

lines.zh: 这一小块地，几步就走完了
lines.en: This little patch is crossed in a few steps.
Folding my wings, I land without a sound.

lines.zh: 我和旁边那只走得一样快
lines.en: I walk as fast as the one beside me.
I circle about, nothing to do.
I crouch, and my tail still twitches.
A few of us huddle together.
I look up; there's nothing in the sky.

lines.zh: 爪子在土里刨了个小坑
lines.en: My claws dig a small pit in the soil.
I stand, waiting for orders from above.
I'm still small, and so is my strength.

lines.zh: 壳上那道缝是生的痕迹
lines.en: The seam on my shell is how I was made.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我数自己的心跳
lines.en: In the quiet I count my own heartbeats.
Don't think I'm dazed.

lines.zh: 风把草吹得沙沙响，我听着
lines.en: The wind rustles the grass, and I listen.

lines.zh: 我这副身材，坐也坐不高
lines.en: With this build I can't sit tall.
Three of them are looking at me.
My wings itch, so I have to shake them.
Why look at me? I'm small.
I know that expression.
Speak down here; you'll have to bend.
I'm not an ordinary child.
There are several more behind me.
Try kicking me.
I'm this small, and you're still afraid.
Your shadow covers me.

lines.zh: 我这身壳是生的，不是长出来的
lines.en: This shell was made, not grown.
Stand back, looking up tires me.

lines.zh: 我跟他们不一样，你最好记住
lines.en: I'm not like them; better remember that.

lines.zh: 别蹲下来，那样我很像宠物
lines.en: Don't crouch; it makes me feel like a pet.

lines.zh: 你看我的爪子，还没长成
lines.en: Look at my claws, still not grown.
I speak softly; you won't hear.

lines.zh: 抬起头，我记住你的脸了
lines.en: I look up and memorize your face.
I'm not here to play.
You're taller than I thought.
A white line rises on my shell.
I back off two steps, wings flapping wild.
It hurts, but I won't cry out.
I'm small; this wound is heavy.
I dodged too slowly and got grazed.
A kin blocked part of it.
I fall into the grass and get up.
My shell has seams, and that's where it stings.
I stare at you and remember.
This much makes me rest a while.
The little ki in your hand, I want it.
I'm small, but not picky.

lines.zh: 给我一粒仙豆，我就不打
lines.en: Give me a senzu bean and I'll hold off.

lines.zh: 你能给多少，我就吃多少
lines.en: However much you can spare, I'll take.
Don't test me with food, I don't eat.
Leave that ball of light and I'll take it.
Several of us are hungry.

lines.zh: 你身上的气在飘，我闻得到
lines.en: Your ki is drifting; I can smell it.
Fill me up and I'll walk away.
So little, enough for whom?
Bump me and you'll learn I'm hard.
Small, but I'm planted.
You stepped on me.
Don't kick at me.

lines.zh: 我们几个挤过来，你站不住
lines.en: A few of us pressing in, you won't hold.
My shell has edges; touching it cuts.
Move a bit, I can't get through.
One touch and I turn on you.
Back off, I hate being stepped on.
Small doesn't mean soft.
We're too small to think of that.

lines.zh: 同一批生出来的，算兄弟姐妹
lines.en: Born in the same batch; that makes us siblings.
We gather, but only for numbers.
I don't really understand this.
That one is identical to me.

lines.zh: 我们不会有下一代，都是造出来的
lines.en: We won't have offspring; we're all manufactured.
Huddling together isn't closeness.
Stop watching, there's nothing to see.
I sniff it, and it smells like me.
We go our own ways; that's how it is.
What falls, I grab first.
I can carry this stone.
Too small to grip in my claws.
I carry it in my mouth; it tastes of nothing.
That thing on the ground, I want it.
I pick it up to play, then drop it.
This weight won't bend me.
Whatever you throw, I catch.
I tuck a bit into my shell seam.
Mine, don't take it.
Something's moving over there.
I see it, no need to point.
A few of us go together.
Being tall won't help you.
I'll circle to the back first.
A wingbeat and I'm in position.
Very close, so I start fast.
That one's ki is thicker than the others'.
There's a gap; I can slip in.
Probe first, no rush.
My tail points that way.

lines.zh: 我一下就能贴到他身上
lines.en: I can stick to him in one bound.
Pick one out of the group.
I've locked onto him.
I'll move when he turns.
The small one is best for a surprise strike.
I circle at his ankles.
He lifts his foot, so I slip aside.
Waiting for his eyes to look elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我矮，他的盾遮不住下面
lines.en: I'm low; his shield can't cover the bottom.

lines.zh: 连击得靠我们几个一起
lines.en: The combo needs several of us together.
A ki blast gathers in my palm.
He can't hit me, I'm too quick.
I'm counting the rhythm of his swings.
Half a lap more and I stick to him.
He backed off; chase.
Don't look up, I'm below you.
Wings fold and I land on his shoulder.
He's looking for others to help.

lines.zh: 这一下要快，不然他会跑
lines.en: This must be quick, or he'll run.
I skim the ground and the grass stays still.
On three, we all go.
His back's to the stone, he can't retreat.
Just this one, no hesitation.
I leap and bite his leg.
A small ki blast bursts up close.
A few of us tear at him at once.
This claw leaves three lines.

lines.zh: 他抬手打我，我从下面钻
lines.en: He swings at me, so I duck under.
I flap dust into his eyes.
The combo's fast; miss one and it breaks.
Around his back for the follow-up.
My tail cracks across his ankle.
We're short, but there are many of us.

lines.zh: 龟派气功？我们也有一点
lines.en: Kamehameha? We have a little of that too.

lines.zh: 他跳起来了，我从下面等
lines.en: He jumped, so I wait below.
I bite and hold so he can't shake me.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，多来几下就重
lines.en: One hit isn't much; many will be.

lines.zh: 他踩到我了，我抓他鞋底
lines.en: He stepped on me, so I rake his sole.
Strike and scatter, don't get caught.

lines.zh: 一批里生出好几个，我是其中一个
lines.en: Several were born in the batch, and I'm one.
I crawl out of the growth tank.
My feet touch ground and I check my kin.
The light here is too bright.
I'm not big, and I'm not afraid.

lines.zh: 从我睁眼起，就有人在喊
lines.en: Since I opened my eyes, someone's been shouting.
A few of us line up.
My shell isn't hard yet; my walk drifts.

lines.zh: 这不是自然生成，是有人放我
lines.en: I don't spawn naturally; someone placed me.

lines.zh: 我落在草丛里，草把我藏住
lines.en: I land in the grass and it hides me.
The first wind I hear is loud.
I look at my own claws.

lines.zh: 命令还没下来，我先站着
lines.en: No orders yet, so I stand.
The one beside me is the same height.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看到很高的东西
lines.en: I look up and see something very tall.
Four shadows, four of us.
I'm one of the slow ones in this batch.

lines.zh: 我从空中落下来，翻了个身
lines.en: I drop from the air and roll once.

lines.zh: 火燎到翅膀，我抖了两下
lines.en: Flame caught my wing and I shook it twice.
I hit ground knees first.
The water's too deep; I thrash hard.

lines.zh: 炸得我翻了两圈，滚进沟里
lines.en: The blast rolled me twice into a ditch.
An arrow grazed my shell and left a mark.
Runes seeped into my shell, very cold.
My ki is running out and I can't stand steady.

lines.zh: 雷打中我，小身子都在抖
lines.en: Lightning struck me and my small body shook.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，什么都抓不住
lines.en: I fall, and there's nothing to grab.
